items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: He was playing with Raymond Burke. Out at a place called the Derby Inn, I believe it is.

ctx.x: And at that, of course, were you living in New Orleans or did you come down here?

No, I never got here until 1937 for the first time. I see. And I'd made a couple trips, just very quick trips here once. The first time I was traveling with the Red Gate Shadowplayers, the Chinese Shadowplay. And I just spent one day here. Mostly a night it was actually. And then the next year I made two trips here with a friend, sort of record hunting trips. We went as far as Florida and Texas to the west. He was from Philadelphia. I just saw him in Bermuda last month. I was surprised. A fellow by the name of…
